svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: FlatResNet3D architecture
svg.desc: FlatResNet3D turns a SAD grid into an ELF grid of the same size. a, the SAD input of CaH6 passes through a 5×5×5 stem convolution with GroupNorm and GELU, a body of four residual blocks and one CBAM block repeated four times, and a 5×5×5 post convolution with GroupNorm. A long skip from after the stem joins at a sum, followed by GELU and a 1×1×1 convolution with a sigmoid. The grid keeps its size and 32 channels from stem to post, and the model has 4,232,989 parameters. b, each of the 16 residual blocks applies a 5×5×5 convolution, GroupNorm, GELU, a second 5×5×5 convolution, GroupNorm, and squeeze-excitation, adds its input back, and applies GELU. c, each of the 4 CBAM blocks applies channel attention from average and max pooling through a shared MLP and a sigmoid, and then spatial attention from average and max maps through a 3×3×3 convolution and a sigmoid, multiplying the features by each result. d, every convolution uses circular padding, so a kernel that crosses the right edge of the unit cell continues on the left edge of the same rows.
